# Revenue Phoenix

> Revenue Phoenix is a founder-led website design, Shopify/WordPress development, and social media management agency based in Agra, India, serving e-commerce and service brands across India, the USA, Canada, the UAE, and Australia. Core services: website & Shopify development, social media handling, and brand strategy. Shopify development packages start at $800, brand strategy starts at $500, with combo packages available. Direct WhatsApp contact: +91 8218690055.

## Services
- [Website design](https://revenuephoenix.com/services/website-design): Fast, mobile-first website design for Indian and global brands. Free demo within 24 hours, clean code, built-in basic SEO, founder-led team. Book a free call.
- [Shopify development](https://revenuephoenix.com/services/shopify-development): Shopify store design, custom Liquid development, migration and Plus builds for D2C brands in India, USA, UAE, Canada and Australia. Packages from $800.
- [Meta Ads management](https://revenuephoenix.com/services/meta-ads): Performance-focused Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads management for D2C, local and service businesses. 1M+ ad spend managed. Clear reporting, no lock-in.
- [Social media management](https://revenuephoenix.com/services/social-media-management): End to end Instagram and social media management for Indian and global brands: strategy, content, reels, posting and monthly reporting. Founder-led, no lock-in.
- [SEO](https://revenuephoenix.com/services/seo): Practical SEO for Shopify stores and business websites: technical fixes, on-page optimisation, local and city pages, content and schema. Clear monthly roadmap.
- [Brand strategy](https://revenuephoenix.com/services/brand-strategy): Brand strategy, positioning, voice and visual identity for D2C and service brands. Starts at $500. Clear direction before design and development.
